name: Filevine MCP
description: Open-source MCP server connecting Claude to Filevine practice management. Built by Oktopeak.

FILEVINE_CLIENT_ID.description: Filevine OAuth client ID (from Settings → Client Secrets)

FILEVINE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Filevine OAuth client secret (from Settings → Client Secrets)

FILEVINE_PAT.description: Filevine Personal Access Token (from Settings → Access Tokens)

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64-character hex string (32 bytes) for AES-256-GCM token encryption
